sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
white_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] in ('W', 'w')]
print(f"Green: {len(green_nodes)}, White/light-gray: {len(white_nodes)}")

# Collect all green blocks
targets = []
for n in green_nodes:
    boundary = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    targets.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col})

result = action(targets, intent='solve')
print(f"After collecting 6 green: done={result.get('done')}, level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}")

# Check what's left
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
white_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] in ('W', 'w')]
print(f"Green remaining: {len(green_nodes)}, White remaining: {len(white_nodes)}")
for n in white_nodes:
    print(f"  White: boundary={n['boundary']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
